duration:
Full-time: 3 to 4 years
Part-time: 6 to 8 years
points: 120 points per year of full-time study

levelOfTraining.required: Level of training and ability necessary to undertake advanced doctoral study in fine arts creative practice and research

supervisionAndResearchRequirements.meetingAcademicRequirements: Meeting our academic requirements does not guarantee entry.
supervisionAndResearchRequirements.researchRequirements: You must demonstrate an ability to research independently, and possess a high level of theoretical understanding. Acceptance is subject to staff availability for supervision, and appropriate resources and facilities.
supervisionAndResearchRequirements.researchIntent: You must write an initial statement of research intent to demonstrate your research capability and experience.
supervisionAndResearchRequirements.englishLanguageRequirements: All students must meet our English-language requirements as a condition of entry.

internationalStudents.notes: Fees are set in advance of each calendar year and will be updated on this website. Fees are inclusive of 15% GST, but do not include the Student Services Fee, course books, travel and health insurance, or living costs. Amounts shown are indicative only. In addition to the tuition fees, there is a Student Services Fee of $9.44 per point, estimated at $1,132.80 for full-time study (120 points). Fees will be confirmed upon completion of enrolment.
